claim: Where auto cannot make an NXC patch, give each build option its own byte so each variant is a valid menu toggle, use --tape-bank for tape games, and check each variant's MD5 against a rebuild from the tape.

evidence.text: One byte per build option makes each variant a valid NXC toggle (same length, distinct bytes: 25 fps 2 bytes, smooth 1, car 1); verified per variant.
evidence.quote: One byte per build option makes each variant a valid NXC toggle (same length, distinct bytes: 25 fps 2 bytes, smooth 1, car 1); verified per variant.

evidence.text: A multiload's stage blocks come from the player's tape with --tape-bank (61,044 bytes from the tape, 3,096 carried); build_screen is the SCREEN$ offset + 3.
evidence.quote: A multiload's stage blocks come from the player's tape with `--tape-bank`: 61,044 bytes from the tape, 3,096 carried; build_screen is the SCREEN$ offset + 3.

evidence.text: Checks: each variant's MD5 from the tape; the loader on the Z80 harness (menu, screen, toggles, trainer, fix off).
evidence.quote: each variant's MD5 from the tape; the loader on the Z80 harness

evidence.text: `nexclash.py patch` makes the whole .nxc since nexclash/nxc.py was re-vendored (SET3); before, the packager could not make an option that needs more memory.
evidence.quote: `nexclash.py patch` makes the whole .nxc since nexclash/nxc.py was re-vendored (SET3)
